They patiently answered all my questions, helped me compare models based on my needs, and even arranged a quick test ride. The entire process—from booking to delivery—was smooth and hassle-free. I really appreciated their transparency with pricing and documentation; there were no hidden charges, and they explained everything clearly.

The scooty was delivered on time, in perfect condition, and with all paperwork neatly organized. They even offered a few freebies and helped with registration and insurance on the spot.

A big thank you to the entire Raj Race Motors team for making my first scooty purchase such a pleasant experience! I’d highly recommend them to anyone looking to buy a two-wheeler with peace of mind.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Gadade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased an Activa from Raj Race Motor Shop. I called them in the afternoon and submitted my documents. I just asked if I could get the vehicle today, and they immediately started the process. Within a few hours, everything was done.

They told me that I would get the vehicle the next day, but I said I wanted it today itself. They quickly agreed and handed over my vehicle at 9:30 PM the same day!

This shows how quick and efficient their service is. Everything was handled very politely and professionally.
I’m really happy with their service. Thank you so much, Raj Race Motor Shop! 🙏🚗
